$comment: THE declaration of omx-strip, the folder's one hand-written file. Every other file of the folder is generated from it by tools/gen.mjs. A chain of omx-dsp instance faces (trim, eq, gate, eq, comp): each element's parameters are by reference to omx-contract's kernel of that element and bind by name to its face. The parameter list is generated from the chain and is append-only.
name: omx strip
description: The OpenMixer console's channel strip in one plugin: input trim, high- and low-pass filters, gate, a parametric EQ of as many bands as its Bands control says, and compressor, in the console's order or any other. No DSP of its own: each stage is omx-dsp's instance face of the console's kernel, called in order.
summary: The console's channel strip in one plugin: input trim, HPF/LPF, gate, EQ of {min:eqBands} to {max:eqBands} bands ({default:eqBands} at first) and compressor, in the desk's order or any other. Stereo, real-time safe.
manual: Five stages, each omx-dsp's instance face of the console's own kernel, run one after the other; each has its own switch:
| Input | on/off; Trim, a click-free ramp to each new gain |
| Filters | on/off; HPF and LPF, each on/off, its frequency, 12 or 24 dB/oct |
| Gate | on/off, threshold, ratio, range, attack, release, knee start and end, hold, hysteresis |
| EQ | on/off; Bands, how many bands run ({range:eqBands}); each band on/off, type (bell, low or high shelf, notch, all-pass 1st or 2nd order), frequency, gain, Q |
| Comp | on/off, threshold, ratio, knee, attack, release, make-up, kind (compressor: RMS detector; limiter: peak), mix, detector oversampling (auto, off, 4x) |
**Order** ({min:order} to {max:order}) picks the order of the five stages: 0 is the desk's input > filters > gate > EQ >
comp, and the rest follow in lexicographic order (1 is input > filters > gate > comp > EQ, ... {max:order} is
comp > EQ > gate > filters > input). Plus the host's bypass. The latency reported is the sum of the
stages': the gate's and the compressor's 4x detector paths while they are engaged, else zero.

0.3.0 changed the parameter list (the Input and Filters switches, the gate's knee, hold and hysteresis, the compressor's kind, mix and detector oversampling, five-stage orders): a session saved with 0.2.0 does not load as it was, though at 0.2.0's settings the strip sounds the same, sample for sample.

**Bands** sets how many of the EQ's band slots run, from the first: a band past it is not processed at all (it costs nothing, and the strip sounds as if it were not there), and keeps its settings for when Bands reaches it again. The bands past the fourth and Bands itself came after the strip's other parameters, so their ids and ports follow all of those: a session or preset saved before them loads with its four bands as they were and Bands at its default.

console.$comment: The OpenMixer console has no channel-strip stage: its strip is the trim, the EQ (with the HPF and LPF), the gate and the dynamics stages themselves. Racked as a plugin in a channel's insert rack, it is drawn by the generic plugin editor.
